applicationChanges: Catalogue DatePicker retains the viewed month and focuses its first day when the typed date is outside it; optional preserveCalendarView leaves the normal component default unchanged
Constrained DatePicker demo validates on change and renders an alert connected through aria-describedby
Orders and Activity tab panels match the reference text after activation

Tooltip demo text and shared tooltip line-height match the reference
